item.title: ‘Rumi in a Ramyeon Cup’ Is the Must-Have 3D Puzzle Inspired by HUNTR/X’s Hungry Lead Singer
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our show! If you're a fan of K-pop or just love solving puzzles, we've got some exciting news for you. This year's hottest toy might just be Rumi in a Ramyeon cup, a 138-piece 3D puzzle from Netflix's K-pop Demon Hunters.
[Short music transition]
Host: This puzzle is unique because it uses pre-cut foam pieces that snap together without any glue or tools. The finished product measures approximately 7.8 x 15 inches and features Rumi eating her branded ramyeon. But that's not all - the puzzle also comes with a larger ramyeon cup that Rumi can sit in, with her name displayed on the back of the lid. You can get it now on Walmart or Amazon for $19.99, which is 9% off the original price.
[Short music transition]
Host: But Rumi in a Ramyeon cup is not the only puzzle available. 4D Build, the puzzle company behind this release, also has a Derpy Tiger and Sussie Bird 3D puzzle kit with 168 pieces. This one features a movable design, so you can change up the look by removing or moving different parts. And if you're looking for something a bit different, there's also a chibi-style puzzle of the entire HUNTR/X crew, with 212 foam puzzle pieces.
[Short music transition]
Host: Last but not least, there's a 3D sneaker puzzle with 108 plastic pieces that snap together. The finished product features an image of HUNTR/X promoting their "Takedown Tour" and can be displayed on its own or used as a pencil cup or small vase. All of these puzzles are officially licensed from Netflix and are available now on Walmart and Amazon.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in, and happy puzzling!
